sections.title: 1. Qualified manual commissioning is a distinct permission
contract: Preserve exact whole fingerprint including GUID, device reply, auxiliary firmware presence/value, transport, log and adapter; preserve installed loader/manager/tool hashes, expiry and reviewer custody. Never substitute family-only fingerprint matching at runtime.

Two v2 action phases only: manual_commissioning and automatic_qualified. The first is a qualified, narrowly authorized single manual operation, not an unqualified override. Its preconditions establish safe invocation before the action; actual completion is evidence generated by that first invocation. The second permits ordinary manual and independently consented automatic operations.

The existing authenticated admin POST, exact-origin/session intent, configured-target checks, shared DB ownership, current identity/revision/credentials, final archive barrier, same-reservation clear, audit, deadline/cooldown and unknown-outcome reconciliation all remain mandatory. No new unauthenticated commissioning endpoint, arbitrary command runner or flag that skips qualification.

Automatic policy opt-in, automatic execute, claim and final dispatch must all reject manual_commissioning even if an old target auto flag is true. Qualified UI/status must expose phase; manual commissioning availability cannot be presented as automatic qualification.

First production scope: CCC93 clear only, once. No clock action or other target is implied by that commissioning record. Eight numeric-offset candidates are future possible clock targets, not already qualified; CCC90–CCC93 clock-held and CCC94 fully excluded.

sections.title: 2. Minimal v2 registry and evidence schema

registry.records: Retain v1 common record fields and strict field/type validation; reject duplicate target/action records and ambiguous matches. actions contains typed v2 action admissions instead of legacy all-true canary check dictionaries.

action_admission_fields.commission_id: Stable UUID for the one owner-approved target/action attempt; preserved across bundle revisions. Not derived from mutable bundle hash.
action_admission_fields.owner_scope_sha256: Digest of retained bounded scope receipt naming exact target/action and one-use limit; not a self-generated consent substitute.
action_admission_fields.claims: Closed claim map: each claim refers to admitted evidence SHA256 values with typed provenance; no blanket physical=true booleans.
action_admission_fields.parent_commission: Required only for promotion: prior envelope SHA256, prior pointer SHA256, commission_id, exact successful operation_id and verified result evidence SHA256.

registry.evidence_artifact_fields: path, sha256, kind; all files referenced exactly and custody/size/digest checks retained.

evidence_kinds.vendor_semantics: Exact model/firmware applicability, immutable captured document hash, cited section/text for conditional erase and insertion/competing-reservation semantics; reviewer records applicability rationale. File may be supporting JSON carrying citations and retained source material digest, never an unsupported assertion.
evidence_kinds.native_guard_observation: Exact target fingerprint, observed UTC, actual operation/probe ID, fixed raw request/response receipts, observation result; only non-destructive reserve/read/info probes. Label observed versus unobserved insertion behavior explicitly.
evidence_kinds.source_guard_verification: Exact final runtime/source identity, test case IDs, environment, actual result/log hashes; explicitly source verification, not physical firmware evidence.
evidence_kinds.commissioning_result: Exact target/action/commission_id/operation_id, original qualification binding, raw receipts, archive IDs/hashes, dispatch intent, readback/outcome and reviewer. Admission cross-checks against actual durable local operation/audit/archive rows, not JSON self-attestation.
evidence_kinds.clock_ownership: Qualified clock path only: retained vendor/native mapping plus full external-writer ownership evidence; NTP=false alone insufficient.
evidence_kinds.ca_certificate: Existing strict public CA parsing/digest binding; current verified BMC request must succeed. No default trust fiction.

source_test_claim_examples: stale token causes no unsafe retry
new events are not removed during verification
registry.compatibility: Keep v1 parser and its exact evidence requirements unchanged. v1 records are eligible only on matching installed runtime identity. Do not reinterpret old all-true fixtures as v2 evidence. v2 can remain inside existing bounded envelope format; schema version belongs to registry and typed evidence.

sections.admission_rule: Each mandatory claim has explicit permitted evidence kinds. A source test cannot fill a vendor/physical claim. For manual clear, vendor evidence plus native guard observations jointly establish hardware applicability; software tests establish implementation guards. Promotion adds actual commissioning_result. Schema validity alone never establishes vendor truth; independent semantic review remains required.

sections.title: 3. One-use ledger and dual archive mechanics
one_use: Add nullable commission_id to existing SELOperation with a UNIQUE index for non-null values; retain rows indefinitely as consumed authorization receipts outside ordinary event/archive retention. Existing operations migrate with NULL. This is a small additive existing-ledger migration, not a second job system.

Under existing BEGIN IMMEDIATE claim transaction, reload current admission/phase, verify exact scope and action, reject any existing row with commission_id, reserve target ownership, insert SELOperation with commission_id and immutable original qualification binding, audit commission_consumed, then commit atomically. A successful claim consumes the one-use authorization even if later pre-dispatch backup fails. Retrying requires a genuinely new root-approved attempt ID/budget; replacing bundles cannot refund it.

Serialize commissioning claim with policy and pointer lifecycle locks as applicable. Revalidate phase and binding at final dispatch. Automatic-qualified ordinary operations use NULL commission_id; promotion references the old consumed commission_id but cannot reuse it to dispatch another commissioning attempt.

Crash after claim, before dispatch: reconcile durable state; no automatic new attempt. After dispatch ambiguity: existing outcome-unknown ownership blocks both actions and registry replacement. Do not infer no effect from timeout. Audit/operation history must survive normal history clearing.

Reject direct promotion unless the referenced operation is locally present, action/target/fingerprint/runtime/qualification binding match, automatic=false, state=complete, outcome=clear_verified, archive integrity and audit/raw completion/readback evidence match, and subsequent ordinary collection evidence is genuine. Do not require an empty post-clear log; new events are valid.
archive: Keep helper code within src/ipmi_monitor/sel_management.py or sel_qualifications.py so existing runtime_identity hashes cover all new authority-relevant behavior; no outside unmeasured helper.

Use existing explicit DATA_DIR/sel-archives with private, checked directories. Filename comes from internal UUID/archive ID, never BMC text or client path. Create mode0600 O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW; verify regular file, owner, link count; bounded write loop, fsync file, fsync directory; reopen no-follow and independently verify exact canonical payload bytes/hash/count.

Canonical snapshot payload binds target ID, full fingerprint/GUID, operation ID, generation, snapshot epoch, same reservation, raw records/info, collected UTC and qualification ID/hash. DB SELArchive payload and file must be byte-identical, not just matching record counts. Keep existing 4MiB bound and command deadline; fail before hardware dispatch on any storage/space/custody/readback error.

Order: claim -> acquire final reservation -> complete snapshot -> create durable DB/archive/audit receipt and durable file -> independent DB and file readback -> final authorization and dual-copy verification -> committed dispatch intent -> clear using identical reservation/session. Never obtain a new reservation after verification to make the clear succeed.

Final barrier must re-read both representations and ensure unchanged operation/target/generation/epoch/reservation/qualification binding immediately before dispatch; bind verified hashes into dispatch audit. Avoid network I/O inside a long DB transaction. Final bounded local file read may occur under existing final authority lock. Same reservation protects intervening BMC events; if invalidated, no fresh-token erase.

Before a future qualified clock action, preserve complete current raw snapshot into the same DB+file archive pair, including valid empty snapshot; do not inherit clear-only nonempty/full requirements. Clock shares ownership and invalidates epoch; retain archive before write, fresh UTC, intended offset and external management evidence. A read-only reservation does not make clock updates conditionally atomic; do not claim it does.

Retention follows existing trusted archive time and entitlement. Active/unknown-operation archives remain protected; DB and file deletion are coordinated only after eligibility, preserving operation/audit authorization receipts. Same-volume copies are two durable verified representations, not independent disaster-recovery failure domains.

sections.title: 4. Supported replacement and tests
replacement: Add explicit replace CLI operation requiring --expected-active-pointer-sha256 and --expected-sha256 for the candidate envelope. Initial install retains existing behavior; replace must not silently fall through to install.

Validate exact existing pointer bytes/digest, private custody, active bundle integrity and current runtime identity; validate complete candidate bundle. Hold existing BEGIN IMMEDIATE authority transaction, require all auto policies OFF and no queued/archiving/mutating/verifying/outcome-unknown operations, then recheck pointer hash before publication.

Retain immutable old/new bundles and pointer-history bytes; new pointer.previous_pointer_sha256 equals exact old pointer SHA. Write and fsync durable transition intent/history before atomic active pointer replacement; fsync directory. Capture transition result. If publication may have happened, return outcome_unknown and require status/reconciliation, never blind replay.

Promotion candidate must point to the current manual commissioning parent and actual local consumed operation; verify as above. Reject missing/foreign/failed/unknown results, changed fingerprint/action, fabricated source-only evidence and reactivation of an already retired pointer. Future rollback is an explicit new reviewed transition, never raw copy of a historical active.json.

Bundle change invalidates previous consent bindings. After supported replacement/status verification, fresh admin policy POST is required for each automatic-qualified action. All policies remain off during replacement. No code path silently re-arms old consent.

Protect against environment-mode precedence: refuse managed install/replace when SEL_QUALIFICATIONS_FILE or SHA environment override is active, or explicitly verify no override in runtime before claiming managed pointer adoption; a valid unused pointer is not activation.
minimal_tests: Extend existing registry tests: v1 unchanged; v2 rejects missing/misclassified claims, forged promotion and mismatched GUID/runtime/action; valid typed manual record cannot arm auto.

Actual authenticated API test: commission-qualified CCC93 manual clear succeeds once through ordinary POST path; CSRF/role/identity denials remain; auto execute/claim/final dispatch independently refuse commissioning phase.
Two SQLite workers race the same commission_id: only one committed claim, including after restart or same ID in a different bundle; consumed failed-pre-dispatch attempt cannot retry.

Real filesystem + SQLite archive test: exact payload persists to both stores; file/DB corruption, failed fsync, unsafe path/link or final mismatch prevents raw Clear command; one parameterized failure test is sufficient.
Reuse persistent real-child same-reservation test; verify final clear still uses original token after second-copy writes and invalidation causes hold/recollection without fresh-token clear.
Replacement CAS race, auto flag/active/unknown operation refusal, retained pointers and crash-after-publication status; no implicit rollback or consent renewal.

Promotion integration checks actual local operation/audit/archive contents and fails if outcome/readback/receipt binding is missing or altered; a syntactically valid evidence JSON alone never promotes.

Existing clock offset, trust, NTP, raw timestamps, retention and no-replay tests remain. Add empty-clock-snapshot backup case when clock commissioning ships; no physical negative clock experiment required.

sections.out_of_scope: No custom command bypass, generic runner/new service, arbitrary file path, credential change, new hardware purchase, forced negative production test, CCC94 operation or silent activation.

sections.title: 5. Reality check and exact stop point
verdict: This design can meet REQ-SEL-002 qualified manual action without bypass: qualification before first clear establishes documented hardware guard semantics and genuine target applicability; completion capability is then confirmed by the one authorized backed-up positive action. The manual admission is intentionally narrower than automatic permission.

Vendor plus non-destructive evidence can be sufficient for that bounded first action if exact applicability is independently established and the vendor material explicitly supports conditional erase with the SAME reservation and invalidation on additions/competing reservations (or a documented equivalent atomic guard). Generic IPMI conformance text or a successful Reserve SEL/Get Entry response alone is insufficient. Real conflicting native observations override documentation.

CCC93 currently has no reviewed evidence packet in this audit establishing those facts. Exact stop: BEFORE installing a manual_commissioning CCC93 record or claiming its one-use operation, root must verify captured vendor applicability, actual native guard receipts and final-source guard tests. If any mandatory hardware behavior remains unknown, hold CCC93 only and identify that missing fact; do not certify it using source tests or blanket all-true checks.

A full SEL may not permit observing natural insertion invalidation. Record that limitation honestly. Specific applicable vendor evidence may establish this behavior for the bounded pilot, with observed competing-reservation invalidation supporting implementation applicability; reviewer must explicitly accept that inference and residual firmware defect risk. Do not represent inference as an observed physical insertion or stale-clear test.

A positive clear alone cannot prove all adverse firmware behavior. Promotion is permitted only when the initial hardware-guard evidence remains sufficient and the actual bounded clear completes with preserved archives/history and ordinary collection. If vendor applicability is uncertain or contradicted, the positive result does not repair that gap.

Clock scope remains later and separate: numeric offset is necessary but insufficient; require exact native semantics, all external writer ownership, actual authenticated CA-trusted time-management observation, fresh trusted UTC, offset restoration/readback and a one-use positive commissioning record before automatic promotion.

Root owns source GO, finite live caps, candidate selection and explicit operational scope. This document authorizes no live action and creates no evidence receipt. Existing old attempt budgets remain spent.
